sentences.en: Layla suffered a stroke days after her forty fourth birthday.
sentences.zh: 拉耶在四十四岁生日后的几天里突然中风。

sentences.en: Cinderella left the party at the final stroke of midnight.
sentences.zh: Cinderella 在午夜的最后一秒离开了舞会。

sentences.en: The lion put an end to his prey with one stroke.
sentences.zh: 狮子用一击结束了它的猎物。
